# MotionHolic

> Video editing agency that researches your market before touching the timeline — so videos don't just look good, they perform. Edits for creators, podcasters, and YouTubers, plus e-commerce brands, business and fitness coaches, and marketing agencies.

MotionHolic has edited 2000+ videos across short-form, long-form YouTube, podcasts, documentary, motion graphics, and ad creatives / VSLs, averaging a 2x engagement boost and a 4.9★ client rating over 5 years.

## Services
- Short-form video editing for TikTok, Reels, and YouTube Shorts
- Podcast editing — clean audio, engaging cuts, custom B-roll
- Documentary-style, story-driven editing
- Ad creative and VSL (video sales letter) editing
- Motion graphics and brand animation
- Long-form YouTube editing for watch time and retention

## Who we work with
- Content creators, podcasters, and YouTubers
- E-commerce brands
- Business and fitness coaches
- Marketing and creative agencies (white-label editing)
- Lifestyle, fashion, and product brands
